gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the workflow scheme associations for a specific project in Jira so that I can understand which workflows are applied to my project's issues.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of workflow schemes associated with the specified project, including details such as the workflow scheme ID, name, and the project key.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to assign a specific workflow scheme to a project so that the project can utilize the defined workflows for issue management.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully update the project to use the specified workflow scheme, returning a confirmation message along with the updated project details.
